item.title: 0.1.5 Beta 2
item.description:
# SakuraCord v0.1.5-Beta-2
SakuraCord v0.1.5 Beta 2 repairs release-track switching and shows the complete beta version everywhere the app identifies itself.
## Release tracks
- Fixed switching from Nightly to Regular so the current Regular release appears in Sparkle’s normal update window and installs through the standard download, verification, and relaunch flow. - Kept downgrade protection enabled for Regular builds while allowing an explicit signed Regular replacement from Nightly. - Updated the app to a verified SakuraCord fork of Sparkle 2.9.6.
## Version labels
- Fixed About, Software Updates, support summaries, and Sparkle’s update window so they identify the installed release as `0.1.5 Beta 2` instead of shortening it to `0.1.5`. - Kept the macOS About panel focused on `0.1.5 Beta 2` without exposing the internal build number used for update ordering.
## Interface
- Removed the duplicate Settings item from the SakuraCord app menu.
## Update reliability
- Moved the Nightly update feed to `sakuracord.app` so it no longer needs a generated source branch. - Republished this repaired Beta 2 with a newer build number so installations of the earlier broken Beta 2 can update normally.
**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.5-Beta-1...v0.1.5-Beta-2](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.5-Beta-1...v0.1.5-Beta-2)
